fix: Decide the placement once so the widget is moved, not cloned: `let (head, detached) = if stacked { (row_of(vec![marker, expanded(label), revert]), Some(editor)) } else { (Row::new(vec![marker, label, expanded(editor), gap(4., 1.), revert]).cross_axis_alignment(CrossAxisAlignment::Start).into(), None) };` then `let mut rows = vec![head];` and `if let Some(editor) = detached { rows.push(Padding::new(EdgeInsets::from_ltrb(MARKER_SLOT, 0., REVERT_SLOT, 0.), editor).into()); }`.

Avoid the String allocation on every build for an existing slot: `if !fields.contains_key(slot) { fields.insert(slot.to_owned(), EditorField { controller: TextEditingController::with_text(text.to_owned()), synced: text.to_owned() }); }` then `let field = fields.get_mut(slot).expect("inserted above");`.
Borrow instead of cloning; `key` is only read by `format!("{key}#v")` in the Text and Raw arms, and `edit` is already a borrow: `let key = &edit.key;`.

`text` is only read (passed as `&text` to `env.editors.field`), so return a borrow: `let text: Cow<str> = match &property.value { DebugValue::Str(text) => Cow::Borrowed(text.as_str()), other => Cow::Owned(debug_value(other)) };` (add `use std::borrow::Cow;`).

Make `enum_text` return `Cow<'_, str>` (`DebugValue::Enum(text) => Cow::Borrowed(text.as_str()), other => Cow::Owned(debug_value(other))`). All three callers (lines 504, 508, 512) only compare or borrow the result, and `&current` / `&enum_text(..)` deref-coerce to `&str`.
`PALETTE` is a `[&str; 12]` const, so the length is known: `let mut swatches = Vec::with_capacity(PALETTE.len());`.

The segment count is `options.len()` with a gap between each, so use `let mut children = Vec::with_capacity(options.len() * 2);`. The same applies to `let mut chips = Vec::new();` in `menu` (line 933), which holds one entry per option: `Vec::with_capacity(options.len())`.
